verified: According to the 68th Top500 list, released at SC26 in Chicago, China's LineShine at the National Supercomputer Center in Shenzhen remains No. 1 at 2.198 FP64 ExaFLOPS on the HPL benchmark at 42.22 MW, and the top 10 is unchanged since June. The list records only 27 new entrants (5.4%), the fewest since the project began in 1993, and aggregate HPL performance of 19.57 FP64 ExaFLOPS, up 4.4% in six months; the most powerful newcomer is South Korea's Hanggang, 12th at 342.6 PFLOPS.
unconfirmed: The claim that AI data centers are absorbing the hardware is an interpretation resting on Epoch AI estimates cited by the list's authors — about 15 million H100-equivalents of installed global AI compute (Epoch AI, January) and five US hyperscalers holding roughly 71% of it as of Q4 2025 — not on a measured attribution of specific missing systems, and the article offers no figures on hardware diverted to AI clusters. All performance, core-count and power numbers come from the systems' Top500 submissions; the outlet reports no independent benchmark of LineShine, and no price or delivery details are given for any machine.

verified: 第68届 Top500 榜单在 SC26 发布，中国深圳国家超算中心的 LineShine 以 HPL 2.198 FP64 ExaFLOPS、42.22 MW 位列第一；前十名与 6 月版本相同，新上榜系统仅 27 台（占 5.4%），为 1993 年榜单创立以来最少——这些是榜单数据及 Tom's Hardware 转述的数字。
unconfirmed: 榜单并未解释新系统偏少的原因，“算力优先流向 AI 数据中心”是本文与 Top500 作者的推断；文中引用的 Epoch AI 估算（全球 AI 算力约合 1500 万块 H100、五大美国云厂商占 71%）为模型估算而非审计数据；LineShine 的成绩基于提交的 HPL 数据，本文未提供独立复测结果。

titles.en: China's LineShine keeps Top500 crown as AI data centers absorb new hardware
titles.zh: 中国LineShine蝉联Top500榜首，新上榜系统仅27台
